learner_operation: Differentiate square-root and reciprocal-square-root functions of linear or quadratic polynomials using the chain rule; in slope questions evaluate the derivative at a specified point. Identify the inner function, apply the outer power rule and inner derivative, then evaluate when a target is given.

fixed_features.feature: Outer exponent +1/2 or -1/2 and inner polynomial degree at most two
fixed_features.justification: Observed source families and canonical e-182; this preserves the chain-rule method.

fixed_features.feature: Positive square radicand at numeric evaluation targets
fixed_features.justification: Real differentiability and comparable easy arithmetic in the captured slope tasks.

fixed_features.feature: Five radio options or a mathematical blank
fixed_features.justification: Captured response contracts; neither correct position nor distractor spacing is essential.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change coefficients or target while retaining positive radicand and source arithmetic.
answer_roles.observed: The same quadratic at x=1,5,9 yields 4/3,0,-4/3. Zero is not a fixed quadratic response.

answer_roles.role: Radio key value, numeric rank and displayed position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Derive the correct scalar from calculus; vary error values, rank and order without answer-bearing spacing.
answer_roles.observed: All ranks 0..4 exercised in each of eight radio templates. Current banks reject equal gaps. No tested incidental cue succeeds on every member of any five-instance template sample.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Hold the function fixed and change its valid target, updating question, solution and grade.
answer_roles.observed: For sqrt(37+7x), x=-4 and -3 give 7/6 and 7/8; actual rendered outputs and native grading agree.

counterfactuals.change: Keep sqrt(-x^2+10x), change x=1,5,9; keep sqrt(37+7x), change x=-4,-3.
counterfactuals.expected: 4/3,0,-4/3 and 7/6,7/8 respectively, including prompt substitutions, solution, key and learner grading.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent exact differentiation, complete native-grader checks and inspected UI screenshots agree for both sets.
counterfactuals.justification: Target evaluation is explicit in q-342792/q-342789 and q-107360/q-107288. Fixing their outcomes would remove necessary evaluation.

counterfactuals.change: Keep sqrt(9+4x), x=0 and rank 2 fixed; change seed 610 to 611, altering distractors and order.
counterfactuals.expected: Correct response 2/3, prompt and worked solution preserved despite changed bank.
counterfactuals.observed: Both records have the same prompt, solution and correct value. All choices graded independently; both UI screenshots inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: The source radio asks for the derivative value, which is independent of surrounding distractors and order.
